row.team_price_text: Core: $18/month billed annually (up to 5 collaborators, flat)
row.evidence: Replit's SCIM doc says "SCIM is available exclusively for Enterprise customers"; the pricing page lists SSO/SAML only on the Custom-priced Enterprise plan.
row.notes: Core ($18/mo billed annually, up to 5 collaborators) and Pro ($90/mo billed annually, up to 15 collaborators) are flat plans with credits, so per-user fields stay null. SAML SSO and SCIM are Enterprise only (Custom pricing; self-serve upgrade with an annual credit commitment, or via sales). SCIM provisions and deprovisions members and syncs pushed groups, which map to workspace roles in Replit; SAML alone has no JIT. Admin API (beta, Enterprise account admins) is read-only for members and groups. idp.generic is null because no SCIM endpoint is published; setup goes through an onboarding portal.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $90/month billed annually ($100 monthly) at the lowest credit tier, up to 15 collaborators

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Self-serve upgrade or via sales; SCIM is enabled by contacting sales.

deprovision.notes: Docs say SCIM deprovisions members but not whether that removes them from the org or suspends them.

attributes.notes: Group names and memberships sync; user attributes are not documented.

roles.how: Group-to-role mapping per workspace in Replit (Admin, Member, Viewer, Guest), plus a designated account admin group; highest role wins.

limitations.text: Microsoft Entra ID does not expand nested groups; use flat groups.
Members who existed before SCIM ('legacy' members) are not automatically removed.
The account admin group can be changed but not cleared.

scim.notes: SCIM is set up through an in-product SCIM onboarding portal that gives IdP-specific steps; the public docs do not publish the SCIM base URL, version, token handling or schema.

auth.notes: Keys begin with rpl_ and are read-only or read and write.

capabilities.notes: Groups can be listed but not changed via the API; no create, update, deactivate or delete user endpoints appear in the OpenAPI spec.

endpoints.purpose: Approve or deny one member access request
List Account messages using the legacy route
List Account messages (prompt text for project.message_sent audit events)

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs are viewed/exported in a portal and streamed to a SIEM; the Compliance API returns prompt text for message audit events.

rate_limits.text: Responses include rate-limit headers; limits are not published.

user_api.notes: Admin API (beta) for Enterprise account admins only. Read-only for members and groups; the only member write is approving or denying Viewer-to-Member seat requests.

okta.notes: Replit names this IdP for SSO and SCIM; setup is via Replit's SCIM onboarding portal. No catalogue listing was confirmed.

entra.notes: Replit names this IdP for SSO and SCIM; setup is via Replit's SCIM onboarding portal. No catalogue listing was confirmed.

google.notes: Google Workspace is a named SAML option; SCIM support for Google is not stated.

fallbacks.notes: SAML sign-in does not add users to the organization; SCIM or invitations are needed.

conflicts.text: The Enterprise plan doc says Enterprise can be bought without contacting sales and includes SSO/SCIM, while the SCIM doc says to contact sales to enable SCIM.

open_questions: SCIM base URL, SCIM version, token type and expiry are not in the public docs (given in the onboarding portal).
Whether SCIM deprovisioning deletes, suspends or removes the member, and whether it frees the seat, is not stated.
Supported SCIM user attributes are not documented.
The pricing page Enterprise card lists SSO/SAML but not SCIM; the SCIM doc says to contact sales to enable it.
Okta OIN / Entra gallery listings for Replit could not be confirmed.
